discovered_cct_skill_lines: - cct-ai-quality: Evaluate substantial AI deliverables and project skills for Controlled Copy Trading using traceable evidence, scope, failure cases and proportionate cost. Use for quality reviews, readiness claims and skill evaluations; does not certify product safety or authorize release. (file: r4/cct-ai-quality/SKILL.md)

- cct-backend-data: Review backend and database boundaries, concurrency, transactions, idempotency and migrations for Controlled Copy Trading. Not an authorization to create production schemas or integrations. (file: r4/cct-backend-data/SKILL.md)

- cct-copy-replay: Review copier replay and backtest feasibility with arrival-time data, liquidity, expenses and project lot rules. Not a live execution adapter or automatic historical-fill simulation. (file: r4/cct-copy-replay/SKILL.md)

- cct-deployment-data-ops: Review deployment, migration, backup restore and financial reconciliation runbooks for safe project operations. Not a production deployment or permission to replay external side effects. (file: r4/cct-deployment-data-ops/SKILL.md)

- cct-figma-handoff: Reconcile Figma components, versions, tokens and project handoff evidence. Use for design collaboration and scoped handoff, not automatic design implementation or library publication. (file: r4/cct-figma-handoff/SKILL.md)

- cct-financial-ux: Review user and admin financial UX for Controlled Copy Trading across RU/EN and mobile/desktop using the existing design system. Not a generic redesign or permission to edit Figma. (file: r4/cct-financial-ux/SKILL.md)

- cct-frontend-quality: Assess frontend state handling, accessibility, responsive behavior and measured performance for this project. Use for frontend review or preparation, not deriving runtime success from mockups. (file: r4/cct-frontend-quality/SKILL.md)

- cct-git-collaboration: Manage scoped Git collaboration and review in the existing project, preserving dirty work and distinguishing commit, push, merge and deploy. Use for Git workflows, not automatic publication. (file: r4/cct-git-collaboration/SKILL.md)

- cct-infrastructure-plan: Compare infrastructure options, environments, capacity, residency, recovery and total cost for this project. Not provisioning resources or selecting a provider by habit. (file: r4/cct-infrastructure-plan/SKILL.md)

- cct-knowledge-curation: Curate, retrieve and refresh project knowledge or learning packs for Controlled Copy Trading with claim-level provenance, versions and applicability. Use for source libraries and conflicting or stale references, not ordinary product implementation. (file: r4/cct-knowledge-curation/SKILL.md)

- cct-market-domain: Review prediction-market and copy-trading semantics, virtual lots, reserves, fees and reconciliation against project ADRs. Use for domain reasoning, not choosing new financial rules. (file: r4/cct-market-domain/SKILL.md)

- cct-product-discovery: Research demand, competitors, incentives and unit economics for Controlled Copy Trading. Use for product discovery and business evidence, not implementation or unrequested outreach. (file: r4/cct-product-discovery/SKILL.md)

- cct-product-qa: Design risk-based acceptance and fault/concurrency tests for user/admin and financial scenarios. Use for product QA planning or authorized review, not writing product features or treating coverage as correctness. (file: r4/cct-product-qa/SKILL.md)

- cct-project-context: Establish scope and current evidence for substantial Controlled Copy Trading tasks, especially when continuing earlier chats or reconciling project plans, ADRs and implementation. Does not initiate product delivery or external actions. (file: r4/cct-project-context/SKILL.md)

- cct-reliability-operations: Assess SLOs, capacity, observability, DDoS resilience and incident response for this project. Use for operational planning and review, not enabling live mitigations without a scoped task. (file: r4/cct-reliability-operations/SKILL.md)

- cct-score-data-audit: Audit provenance, temporal availability, identity and ledger completeness for trader-score datasets. Not a score formula design or permission to fill missing cashflows with assumptions. (file: r4/cct-score-data-audit/SKILL.md)

- cct-score-explanation: Review score explanations, uncertainty, coverage and financial visualizations for novice users. Not converting a 0–100 index into profit probability or marketing guarantees. (file: r4/cct-score-explanation/SKILL.md)

- cct-score-governance: Plan score versioning, data lineage, monitoring, stale handling and rollback under project admin rules. Not a manual score editor or production publishing authority. (file: r4/cct-score-governance/SKILL.md)

- cct-score-methodology: Research trader-score targets, baselines, uncertainty and candidate methodology using audited copier evidence. Not automatic acceptance or publication of new formulas or weights. (file: r4/cct-score-methodology/SKILL.md)

- cct-score-validation: Challenge score and replay claims with temporal/group splits, leakage checks, uncertainty and stress tests. Use for methodological validation, not fitting on the holdout or certifying profit. (file: r4/cct-score-validation/SKILL.md)

- cct-server-hardening: Prepare or review environment-specific server provisioning and hardening runbooks with recovery access and evidence. Does not grant authorization to connect to or modify servers. (file: r4/cct-server-hardening/SKILL.md)

- cct-venue-api-review: Verify documented and observed venue API capabilities, freshness, account scopes and limits for Polymarket and Limitless. Not an execution client or automatic permission for account experiments. (file: r4/cct-venue-api-review/SKILL.md)

- cct-wallet-security: Review wallet, signer, user/admin authorization and abuse risks against project trust boundaries. Use for threat modeling and security evidence, not certification or live key operations. (file: r4/cct-wallet-security/SKILL.md)
